subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: After the page-limit repair, should cold Mattermost thread recovery remain one awaited attempt per stored thread session, with a five-second timeout and no retry after transient failure?
rationale: Both choices are technically viable but trade recovered session context against repeated inbound latency and server load; repository evidence cannot determine the intended channel policy.

options.title: Keep bounded best-effort recovery
options.body: Accept one five-second attempt per stored session so normal follow-ups never repeatedly block on an unavailable Mattermost server.

options.title: Retry transient failures
options.body: Allow a narrowly bounded later retry so a temporary outage does not leave the entire stored session without recovered thread context.

recommendation.title: Keep bounded best-effort recovery
recommendation.body: Accept one five-second attempt per stored session so normal follow-ups never repeatedly block on an unavailable Mattermost server.
